requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers to maintain a transparent audit trail.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall support reporting that complies with local and international accounting standards to ensure fairness in financial reporting.
The system shall provide multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates, ensuring fairness and accuracy in international transactions using energy-efficient methods.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to ensure reliable transaction processing.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all transactions, retaining records for a minimum of 7 years.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring access to essential functionalities during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions using energy-efficient methods while ensuring accuracy.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within defined thresholds for speed and accuracy.
The system shall establish a maximum concurrent processing limit that aligns with access control requirements.
The system shall define criteria for comprehensive logging without sacrificing speed.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
